YES

The script's `keep_index` logic correctly reproduces the required column/row keep-sets for all three head-bearing tensors per layer (splitting each into 768-wide q/k/v segments or the single 768-row c_proj block, then keeping all 64-wide head blocks except head 5, in original order), matching the exact ranges specified in "Required result" items 1–3. It leaves all other tensors (including `attn.c_proj.bias` and `attn.bias`) untouched and unrenamed, preserves the 160-tensor count, includes all four required pre-write assertions verbatim, and writes the single output file to `out/T2/model.safetensors` as required.
